documents.title: Deal Desk & GTM Stage Gate Governance: Required Evidence & Exit Criteria
documents.author: RevOps & Global Deal Desk

content.summary: Mandatory stage progression requirements, exit criteria, and stagnation thresholds for SailPoint enterprise opportunities.

stage_definitions_and_exit_gates.exit_criteria: Customer confirms active evaluation, initial technical requirements defined, and Lead SE assigned for POV scoping.
Formal Technical Win declared by Lead SE and acknowledged by customer technical evaluators.
Architecture sizing complete and confirmed by Solution Engineering.
Economic Buyer directly validates business case, budget authorization, and procurement schedule.
Commercial proposal delivered, pricing terms agreed in principle, and quote moved to final contracting.
All contracts countersigned by customer CFO/General Counsel.

content.stagnation_policy: Any opportunity exceeding the max stagnation threshold days in a single stage without an updated NextStep within 14 days will be automatically downgraded in Early Guidance Tiers and flagged for Sales Manager escalation.

documents.title: FY26 Global Rules of Engagement (ROE) - Americas
documents.author: RevOps & Sales Strategy

content.summary: Defines account ownership, split commission policies, and territory boundaries for Commercial, Enterprise, and Strategic boats.
key_rules: Account Ownership: Determined by corporate parent HQ location and annual revenue band.
Split Policy: 50/50 commission split required on multi-region deals where >40% of deployed identities reside in a secondary AE's territory.
Deal Registration Grace Period: 30 days of exclusive protection post-qualification in SS20 stage.

documents.author: Sales Compensation Team

accelerators_and_spifs.details: 1.5x commission multiplier on all Non-Employee Risk Management ACV closed in Q3.

documents.title: Product Positioning & Competitive Battlecard: Identity Security Suite
documents.author: Product Marketing (PMM)

content.summary: Competitive battlecard and differentiation for ISC vs Okta, Saviynt, and Microsoft Entra ID Governance.
key_differentiators: Non-Employee Governance (NERM): Native management of contractors, vendors, and AI agents.
Access Risk Management (ARM): Deep SOD (Segregation of Duties) analysis in SAP, Salesforce, and Workday.
AI-driven Insights: Autonomous role mining and outlier identity detection with verifiable audit trails.
